text: 金十数据8月28日讯，中国人民银行有关部门负责人就《关于改革完善房地产信贷管理推动加快构建房地产发展新模式的意见》答记者问。建立开发贷款主办银行制度，提升房地产行业转型发展的金融服务能力。《意见》明确，单个房地产项目对应一家主办银行，单独或牵头银团发放开发贷款。开发贷款期限应与项目建设、销售周期相匹配，覆盖项目开工到竣工备案全过程，预售项目最长5年，现房销售项目最长7年，商业地产项目最长7年，首次还本日期原则上应在项目竣工备案后。
text_en: Jin Shi Data, August 28 — A relevant official from the People's Bank of China answered reporter questions on the Opinions on Reforming and Improving Real Estate Credit Management to Accelerate the Establishment of a New Model for Real Estate Development. Establish a lead bank system for development loans to enhance financial service capabilities for the transformation and development of the real estate industry. The Opinions clarifies that a single real estate project corresponds to one lead bank, which issues development loans individually or as the lead bank of a syndicate. The development loan term should match the project construction and sales cycle, covering the entire process from project start to completion filing, with a maximum of 5 years for presale projects, a maximum of 7 years for completed property sales projects, and a maximum of 7 years for commercial real estate projects. The first principal repayment date should generally be after the project's completion filing.
